name: Personal Chef
tagline: Plans your household's dinners each week with recipes, a grocery list and a ready cart
description: Six setup questions capture who you cook for, then it delivers a fresh dinner plan every week. Each plan arrives with printable recipe cards, one grocery list covering all of it, and a Walmart cart already filled so you only have to check out. No personal data leaves with its install counter.
author: ChefMcMakin
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
